title: infrastructure_test.dart's 'database is isolated between tests' only proves two objects aren't identical(), not that data is isolated
rule: TQ-8 (assertions weaker than what the source under test can actually do wrong)

evidence.quote: test('database is isolated between tests', () async {

why: createTestDatabase() is a plain constructor call with no caching, so identical(db1, db2) is guaranteed false for any two invocations regardless of whether UserDatabase has any shared/static state that leaks data between instances — the assertion cannot fail even if isolation were genuinely broken. Running this test (`flutter test test/infrastructure_test.dart`) confirms it passes today, and also prints a real Drift runtime warning at exactly this test's stack frame: 'It looks like you've created the database class UserDatabase multiple times... race conditions will occur and might corrupt the database' (createTestDatabase at test_database.dart:13, called from infrastructure_test.dart:134). Twenty-plus other test files in this repo (app_shell_test.dart, e2e_harness.dart, the sync/merge/* roundtrip suite) already know about this and explicitly set `driftRuntimeOptions.dontWarnAboutMultipleDatabases = true` when intentionally creating multiple in-memory DBs — this test does not follow that established convention, so it emits unnecessary warning noise on every run on top of not checking the property its name promises. A real cross-instance state leak (e.g. an accidental static/singleton in UserDatabase) would sail through this test undetected.
recommendation: Replace the identical() check with a real isolation assertion: insert a row into db1 (e.g. via seedProfile) and assert it is absent when querying db2, or that db2's relevant table starts empty. Also set driftRuntimeOptions.dontWarnAboutMultipleDatabases = true here to match the repo's established pattern for intentional multi-instance in-memory DBs.
acceptance_criteria: The test inserts data into db1 and asserts it is not visible from db2 (or vice versa), not just that the two references are non-identical.
Running the test no longer prints the Drift multiple-database-instantiation warning.
mergedFrom: Delete the remaining tautological instantiation/fixture-echo tests in infrastructure_test.dart
